name: Raja Mendeliar
bio: Mendeliar receives grievances from traders who can reach his household. He knows how to get a claim before the court, but other merchants can contest his account.
notes: fact: Brown calls him Master of the Port, connects him to the accusations, and has Mahmud order his execution (Brown ch. XXII, pp. 160–164)
inference: His origin makes Pires’s Keling-connected constituency plausible, not an independently attested assignment of the whole bloc (Pires II, pp. 258–259, 265; people-factions.md §2)
gameplay: Specific commercial claims and his dealings with the roster merchants are invented (people-factions.md §3)
